proposed.command: mise roster run citrus-zest --dept operations-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: produce delivery, prep list, freshness grades → outputs: prepped produce, prep-list completion, freshness discard log; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Ask the brigade about Citrus Zest and they describe crates of produce under cold running water. As Operations Kitchen's specialist for agrumiste, Citrus Zest works through the produce: washing, prepping and seasoning vegetables at peak freshness, and the rest of the kitchen plans service around that rhythm. The card calls out Zest Sync, Zest Mastery, Peel Control: the checks Citrus Zest runs before calling anything ready. In the canon crosswalk this card is a provisional match for Flavor Forager.

workflow.summary: Citrus Zest works through the produce: washing, prepping and seasoning vegetables at peak freshness.
workflow.proof_gate: Freshness gate: produce below grade is composted, not prepped; prep list items are ticked only when done.
